## Checklist

- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`) and follow Conventional Commits
- [ ] `uv run ruff check`, `uv run ruff format --check`, `uv run mypy --strict src`, `uv run pytest -q` pass
- [ ] A new CLI flag has a CliRunner test
- [ ] Architecture changes have an ADR
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` is updated
